title: p-Hydroxy benzaldehyde, a phenolic compound from Nostoc commune, ameliorates DSS-induced colitis against oxidative stress via the Nrf2/HO-1/NQO-1/NF-kappaB/AP-1 pathway.
authors: Liu, Meng; Guan, Guoqiang; Wang, Yuhui; Lu, Xi; Duan, Xiaoqun; Xu, Xiaotian
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然化合物HD通过Nrf2/NF-kB等信号通路缓解结肠炎，虽含分子对接与MD模拟，但核心是药物-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题TF-DNA结合机制无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Ulcerative colitis (UC), a chronic idiopathic inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), presents with limited current drug treatment options. Consequently, the search for safe and effective drug for UC prevention and treatment is imperative. Our prior studies have demonstrated that the phenolic compound p-Hydroxybenzaldehyde (HD) from Nostoc commune, effectively mitigates intestinal inflammation. However, the mechanisms underlying HD's anti-inflammatory effects remain unclear. PURPOSE: This study delved into the pharmacodynamics of HD and its underlying anti-inflammation mechanisms. METHODS: For in vivo experiments, dextran sodium sulfate (DSS)-induced colitis mouse model was established. In vitro inflammation model was established using lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-induced RAW264.7 and bone marrow-derived macrophages (BMDMs). The protective effect of HD against colitis was determined by monitoring clinical symptoms and histological morphology in mice. The levels of inflammatory factors and oxidative stress markers were subsequently analyzed with enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA) and biochemical kits. Furthermore, western blotting (WB), immunofluorescence (IF), luciferase reporter gene, drug affinity reaction target stability (DARTS) assay, molecular docking, and molecular dynamics (MD) simulation were used to determine the potential target and molecular mechanism of HD. RESULTS: Our findings indicate that HD significantly alleviated the clinical symptoms and histological morphology of colitis in mice, and curtailed the production of pro-inflammatory cytokines, including TNF-alpha, IL-6, IFN-gamma, COX-2, and iNOS. Furthermore, HD stimulated the production of SOD, CAT, and GSH-px, enhanced total antioxidant capacity (T-AOC), and reduced MDA levels. Mechanically, HD augmented the expression of Nrf2, HO-1, and NQO-1, while concurrently downregulating the phosphorylation of p65, IkappaBalpha, c-Jun, and c-Fos. ML385 and siNrf2 largely attenuated the protective effect of HD in enteritis mice and RAW 264.7 cells, as well as the promotion of HO-1 expression levels. ZnPP-mediated HO-1 knockdown reversed HD-induced inhibition of colonic inflammation. Luciferase reporter assay and IF assay confirmed the transcriptional activation of Nrf2 by HD. DARTS analysis, molecular docking, and MD results showed high binding strength, interaction efficiency and remarkable stability between Nrf2 and HD. CONCLUSION: These outcomes extend our previous research results that HD can combat oxidative stress through the Nrf2/HO-1/NQO-1/NF-kappaB/AP-1 pathways, effectively alleviating colitis, and propose new targets for HD to protect against intestinal barrier damage.
abstract_zh: 背景：溃疡性结肠炎（ulcerative colitis, UC）是一种慢性特发性炎症性肠病（inflammatory bowel disease, IBD），目前可用的药物治疗选择有限。因此，寻找安全有效的药物用于UC的预防和治疗势在必行。我们先前的研究表明，来自发菜（Nostoc commune）的酚类化合物对羟基苯甲醛（p-Hydroxybenzaldehyde, HD）能有效缓解肠道炎症。然而，HD抗炎作用的潜在机制仍不清楚。目的：本研究深入探讨了HD的药效学及其潜在的抗炎机制。方法：在体内实验中，建立了葡聚糖硫酸钠（dextran sodium sulfate, DSS）诱导的结肠炎小鼠模型。体外炎症模型使用脂多糖（lipopolysaccharide, LPS）诱导的RAW264.7和骨髓来源巨噬细胞（bone marrow-derived macrophages, BMDMs）建立。通过监测小鼠的临床症状和组织学形态，评估HD对结肠炎的保护作用。随后，使用酶联免疫吸附测定（enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay, ELISA）和生化试剂盒分析炎症因子和氧化应激标志物的水平。此外，采用蛋白质印迹（western blotting, WB）、免疫荧光（immunofluorescence, IF）、荧光素酶报告基因、药物亲和反应靶标稳定性（drug affinity reaction target stability, DARTS）测定、分子对接和分子动力学（molecular dynamics, MD）模拟来确定HD的潜在靶点和分子机制。结果：我们的研究结果表明，HD显著缓解了小鼠结肠炎的临床症状和组织学形态，并抑制了促炎细胞因子的产生，包括TNF-α、IL-6、IFN-γ、COX-2和iNOS。此外，HD刺激了SOD、CAT和GSH-px的产生，增强了总抗氧化能力（T-AOC），并降低了MDA水平。在机制上，HD增强了Nrf2、HO-1和NQO-1的表达，同时下调了p65、IκBα、c-Jun和c-Fos的磷酸化。ML385和siNrf2在很大程度上减弱了HD在肠炎小鼠和RAW 264.7细胞中的保护作用，以及HO-1表达水平的促进。ZnPP介导的HO-1敲低逆转了HD诱导的结肠炎症抑制。荧光素酶报告基因测定和IF测定确认了HD对Nrf2的转录激活。DARTS分析、分子对接和MD结果显示Nrf2与HD之间具有高结合强度、相互作用效率和显著稳定性。结论：这些结果扩展了我们先前的研究成果，表明HD可以通过Nrf2/HO-1/NQO-1/NF-κB/AP-1通路对抗氧化应激，有效缓解结肠炎，并为HD保护肠道屏障损伤提出了新靶点。
